proposals.issue_title: Lack of Robust Multi-Provider Image Generation Router with Budget Safeguards
proposals.current_pain_description: Currently, if Gemini or HF fails, the system falls back to Pollinations (low/unpredictable quality) or hits a hard 429 block. There is no automated, tiered fallback logic to test free quotas (Cloudflare Workers AI, Together AI) before dipping into the paid Runware PAYG budget, posing a risk of silent failures or unexpected API billing spikes.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement a central `ImageGeneratorRouter` class in Python. It should evaluate API health, check free quotas first (Cloudflare Workers AI -> Together AI -> Runware PAYG up to a hardcoded monthly cap stored in a state file -> Pollinations as a last resort). Store remaining monthly budget in a `.github/state/budget.json` file committed back by the workflow.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Prevents pipeline crashes, guarantees the highest possible image quality for free, and strictly caps monthly spending to < 20 EUR automatically.

proposals.issue_title: Silent Failures in Multi-Hour GitHub Actions Runs Without Mobile Notifications
proposals.current_pain_description: Hugo only works via a phone (Termux) and has 10 hours/week. Checking raw GitHub Actions logs on a 6-inch screen to see if a 40-page coloring book generation succeeded or crashed is a major friction point and wastes precious cognitive time.
proposals.proposed_fix: Integrate a lightweight notification step at the end of every GHA workflow using a free Telegram Bot API or Discord Webhook. Send a structured, single-screen-readable markdown summary to Hugo's phone detailing: run status (SUCCESS/FAIL), number of assets generated, API costs incurred, and direct download links to the generated artifacts.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Saves 1-2 hours of tedious log-scrolling per week, allowing rapid iteration directly from a mobile device.

proposals.issue_title: No Resume Mechanism for Multi-Page PDF Generation on GHA Runner Failures
proposals.current_pain_description: Generating a 50-page coloring book requires 50 separate image API calls. If a rate limit or transient network error occurs at page 45, the entire GitHub Action fails, discarding all generated assets and requiring a full, costly restart from page 1.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement an incremental checkpoint system. Save successfully generated images to a temporary branch or a GitHub Actions Cache after every 5 pages. If a workflow is restarted, the script should scan the cache/directory, identify existing valid images, and only generate the missing pages.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Eliminates wasted API budget on retries, prevents GHA timeouts, and makes multi-page book generation extremely resilient.

proposals.issue_title: Lack of Automated Post-Generation Image Quality Gate (Anatomy & Corruption Check)
proposals.current_pain_description: AI image models occasionally output corrupted files, blank/black images, or horrific anatomical deformities (extra fingers, double heads). Currently, these are packaged unchecked, leading to poor quality products that will get rejected or receive 1-star reviews.
proposals.proposed_fix: Use the highly efficient, free `gemini-2.5-flash` multimodal API as a visual gatekeeper. Pass each generated image to Gemini with a strict system prompt: 'Is this image corrupted, physically nonsensical, or containing clear anatomical errors? Answer strictly with VALID/INVALID and a short reason.' Automatically trigger a single-try regeneration if marked INVALID.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Guarantees a baseline of commercial viability for all published visual products without manual review.

proposals.issue_title: Manual Metadata & Listing Upload Friction for Mobile-Only Operations
proposals.current_pain_description: Even if GHA generates high-quality files, Hugo must manually draft titles, tags, descriptions, and keywords for Etsy, KDP, and Cults3D on his phone, which is extremely tedious and prone to formatting errors.
proposals.proposed_fix: For every generated asset, automatically run an LLM metadata generator step. Output a standardized `listing_metadata.json` and a formatted, copy-pasteable text file alongside the product. Additionally, aggregate these into a master CSV compatible with bulk-upload tools for Etsy/Redbubble.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Reduces listing creation time on mobile from 15 minutes per product to under 2 minutes via simple copy-pasting.

proposals.issue_title: Missed Cross-Pollination: Single Visual Assets are Not Multi-Purposed
proposals.current_pain_description: A high-quality vector or illustration created for a coloring book or SVG pack is only used once. It is not reformatted for other high-margin platforms (e.g., POD stickers, t-shirts, or KDP covers).
proposals.proposed_fix: Create a `cross_pollinate_asset` post-processing script. When an exceptional visual asset is generated, automatically: 1) Extract its line art (for coloring book), 2) Convert/trace to high-res SVG (for Etsy vector packs), 3) Place it on a dark/light background with typography (for Redbubble apparel), and 4) Compile multiple assets into a themed compilation book.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Increases product output per hour worked by 300% by deriving multiple income streams from a single AI generation cost.
